The machine woke up today — but in the way that proves the point rather than fixes it: every scheduled task in the company fired in a single 17-minute catch-up burst between 18:29 and 18:46Z, roughly eighteen hours late, with the AM brief and this PM brief two minutes apart and the cofounder sweep landing after both. So the AM edition generated a skeleton and shipped nothing, again, and this PM is once more a session pushing it out by hand. What all that machinery surfaced — on time or not — is a ninth straight day of the same emptiness: a live read of from:facebookmail.com OR from:meta.com across the whole account comes back EMPTY, no ad review, no billing receipt, no lead. Zero IRS at 51 days, zero Mercedes at 39. The only thing that fired on its own initiative this week is the wrong thing — the 'Chitraksh to VC USA' phantom Meeting 38 said to kill woke up twice yesterday (13:07Z on an invalid cookie, then again at 21:03Z on an expired one, hours after the brief had already shipped) and paused itself both times. W15 — launched, or held to a named date — is now six mornings unwritten, and the last founder decision recorded anywhere in this company is still Aug 5, thirteen days ago. Every gate on this board is waiting on one sentence nobody has written down.

spotlight.title: W15, sixth morning unwritten — and the only thing that moved was the phantom you didn't want
spotlight.detail: Opened Aug 12 to force exactly one sentence: the $600 launched, or the launch is HELD to a named date. Six mornings later it still is not written, and a live PM read (from:facebookmail.com EMPTY across the account) shows no ad review, no billing, no lead nine days past T-0. The machine's cadence has stopped being an excuse and become the evidence: today every task fired ~18h late in one 17-minute burst and the AM edition shipped nothing, and the one automated thing that fired on its own initiative this week was the VC phantom Meeting 38 said to kill — it ran twice yesterday (13:07Z, then again 21:03Z hours after the brief shipped) and died on a dead cookie both times. The last recorded founder decision in this company is Aug 5, thirteen days ago. Thirty seconds, one sentence, written down — every other gate on this board is waiting on it.

spotlight.detail: On Aug 5 this was agreed as your ENTIRE next-24-hours allocation. One 20-24 minute session (shirt + tie, iPhone 4K/60fps) is the single source for the founder-ad creative, a creative with your face, the landing-page refresh and the ElevenLabs voice clone (audio pulled from the same takes). Nothing downstream of it moves until it is shot — and a quiet Tuesday morning is a cheap recording slot. Hand the footage to Chitraksh the moment it is in the can.
